Operit Music Studio: original TypeScript UI/scheduler and C/WebAssembly DSP.
MIDI demos: THE_WORLD_REVOLVING_[Jevil's_Battle_Theme]_-_DELTARUNE.mid and The_Field_of_Hopes_and_Dreams_(Deltarune).mid, supplied by the user; preserved verbatim in resources/midi/. Workstation playback uses original synthesis, not source instrument sounds.
No Tone.js runtime, samples, SoundFonts, fonts, third-party presets or IR recordings are bundled.
Build/test dependencies: TypeScript (Apache-2.0), esbuild (MIT), fflate (MIT), Playwright (Apache-2.0), LLVM (Apache-2.0 with LLVM exceptions).
Serum and Kontakt are not included, endorsed or proprietary-compatible products.
